fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: A trampling strike that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.3 times their remaining damage to the hit. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max 40%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Worrying the Stragglers
fusions.desc: Nips and stamps at everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 7 damage, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: On the Long Drive
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 18% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Blue Heeler
fusions.desc: A bonded herding dog runs at your heels, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
